text: Before go-live, the team runs a full practice month-end close -- sample invoices, real workflow, nothing touching production data yet.
PO-matched invoices post to the correct warehouse automatically, and a test journal routes straight to Simone Alvarez for approval.
Every subledger total reconciles exactly against the General Ledger, down to the dollar, at the company level.
The dry run checks totals and workflow thoroughly. It never traces a standalone invoice by its own warehouse's Cost Center -- there's no reason yet to think it would matter.
The simulation passes. The team feels ready. The real first close is next.
